_comment: Maintained manually. Each entry is a real, verified file:line reference, re-checked every pipeline run by scripts/verify-stride-coverage.mts for staleness. Do not add an entry unless it has been read and confirmed live in the repo. An empty category list is honest and intentional, not an oversight.

Spoofing.description: AddressScreener.screen() -- real OFAC SDN sanctioned-identity screening. Wired, Zone 3 (ofac-screening scanner, runs every cycle).
claimOriginBonus() authorizes via tx.origin (SWC-115): an attacker's intermediate contract can spoof the legitimate caller's identity. Fixed at contracts/solidity/SecureVault.sol:145 with onlyOwner.

Tampering.description: Live check that Slither's reentrancy-eth detector actually fired this run -- unauthorized state tampering via reentrant calls. Wired, Zone 2 SAST.
echidna_withdraw_never_reentered() -- wired Echidna invariant, genuinely falsified with a real counterexample on VulnerableVault.

Repudiation.description: Writes the immutable, timestamped reports/verdict.json audit trail (halt_reasons, contract_halt_reasons, generated_at) every run. Wired, always runs.
dispatch_sev1_ticket() -- creates a permanent, timestamped external Jira record of exactly what was detected and when. Wired via run-incident-abort.py on the HALT path.

Information Disclosure.description: Real `gitleaks detect` invocation scanning committed source for disclosed secrets/credentials. Wired, Zone 1, always runs.
Attestation report object constructed here; the private witness (blinding factors) is never included in it -- see this file's own HONEST SCOPE docstring. Wired, Zone 3.

Denial of Service.description: batchRefund() has an unbounded loop with no cap on recipients.length (gas-griefing DoS). Flagged live by Slither's calls-loop check.
MAX_BATCH = 50 -- the real fix capping batchRefund()'s loop bound.

Elevation of Privilege.description: check_ownership_protection() -- wired, Zone 2/3 rugpull detector, flags privileged functions with no ownership protection (missing_ownership_protection=fail confirmed live).
setFeeCollector() has zero access control -- the real example the above check flags.
